name: Health / athletic
description: Training, symptoms, measurements, protocols, injuries, and goals.
purpose: Track health, training, symptoms, protocols, measurements, and evidence without turning raw logs into unsupported conclusions.
audience: Athletes, patients, coaches, health experimenters, and people managing personal records with professional oversight.
beginner_description: Use this for workouts, symptoms, injuries, measurements, protocols, appointments, and health records.
agent_instructions: Use record_memory for observed training sessions, symptoms, measurements, and protocol events; this is guidance only and selecting the pack creates nothing. Keep external documents as Sources or Evidence. Do not infer medical advice or progress. Compile only explicit conclusions, decisions, and experiment summaries with links and review prompts.

suggested_workflows.title: Log a training or symptom record
suggested_workflows.intent: Capture observations without prematurely turning them into conclusions.
suggested_workflows.route: record_memory(action=append) for a configured Record collection; use record_memory(action=query) for bounded history, and preserve external proof separately

suggested_workflows.title: Review a protocol change
suggested_workflows.intent: Compare what changed after a protocol, injury, or intervention.
suggested_workflows.route: record_memory(action=query) for the configured collection, then review the observed data without inferring medical or performance judgments
suggested_workflows.example: What changed after the new protocol?

examples: Give me a template for logging these sessions.
What changed after the new protocol?
